description: W3Ship Commerce MCP Server — AI-powered shopping cart, orders, shipment tracking & VR booking via Model Context Protocol. Passwordless commerce using cryptographic identity (SLH-DSA / ECDSA).
author: W3Ship Team

tool_signatures.name: add_item
tool_signatures.description: Add an item to an existing shopping cart. Uses W3SHIP_PUBLIC_KEY as cartId if not provided.

tool_signatures.name: add_tracking
tool_signatures.description: Seller tool: Add real shipping tracking info to an order after shipping the item. Provides the buyer with a tracking number and carrier.

tool_signatures.name: check_token_approval
tool_signatures.description: Check if a token is approved for swapping on Uniswap. Returns whether approval is needed and the approval transaction if so. Requires UNISWAP_API_KEY env var.

tool_signatures.name: claim_promo
tool_signatures.description: Claim a FREE promotional listing. Items are $0. For shipping promos you pay shipping only; for pickup promos it is completely free. One claim per wallet. Must have a registered W3Ship/Dah.mx identity (address required for shipping, wallet-only for pickup).

tool_signatures.name: confirm_payment
tool_signatures.description: Submit an on-chain payment transaction for verification. After paying the seller (send crypto to their wallet address), provide the transaction hash here to verify payment and update the order status to

tool_signatures.name: create_cart
tool_signatures.description: Create a new TMF663 shopping cart. If W3SHIP_PUBLIC_KEY is configured, it is used automatically — no id required. Otherwise provide an SLH-DSA or ECDSA public key (hex).

tool_signatures.name: create_listing
tool_signatures.description: Create a P2P marketplace listing. Anyone can sell items — no merchant onboarding needed. Specify title, price, currency (USDC/ETH/etc), and your wallet address for payment.

tool_signatures.name: create_order
tool_signatures.description: Convert a Shopping Cart into a confirmed Order (TMF622) and initiate fulfillment.

tool_signatures.name: delete_cart
tool_signatures.description: Delete a shopping cart.

tool_signatures.name: generate_demo_key
tool_signatures.description: Generate a demo ECDSA key pair for testing. Returns a public key hex that can be used with create_cart and other tools. Useful for trying out the commerce flow without a real wallet.

tool_signatures.name: get_available_slots
tool_signatures.description: Get available session time slots for a location on a given date. Returns times, capacity, pricing, and activity type. Works for any bookable service (VR, fitness, dining, salon, etc.).

tool_signatures.name: get_cart
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a shopping cart by its Public Key ID. Uses W3SHIP_PUBLIC_KEY if no id is provided.

tool_signatures.name: get_identity
tool_signatures.description: Show the currently configured identity (W3SHIP_PUBLIC_KEY). Returns the public key and its type if set, or instructions on how to configure one.

tool_signatures.name: get_listing
tool_signatures.description: Get full details of a specific marketplace listing by ID.

tool_signatures.name: get_order
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Order (TMF622).

tool_signatures.name: get_swap_quote
tool_signatures.description: Get a swap quote from Uniswap. Returns estimated output, routing path, gas fees, and price impact. Supports V2, V3, V4, and UniswapX protocols. Requires UNISWAP_API_KEY env var.

tool_signatures.name: hold_slot
tool_signatures.description: Hold/reserve a session time slot for a customer. The slot is held for 10 minutes pending payment. Works for any bookable service.

tool_signatures.name: list_bookings
tool_signatures.description: List all confirmed session bookings. Optionally filter by location or date.

tool_signatures.name: remove_listing
tool_signatures.description: Remove a marketplace listing. Only the seller can remove their own listing.

tool_signatures.name: search_listings
tool_signatures.description: Browse the W3Ship P2P marketplace. Search by category (electronics, gifts, clothing, etc.) or keyword. Returns active listings with prices and seller info.

tool_signatures.name: ship_address
tool_signatures.description: Securely retrieve a physical address using a public key and a timed cryptographic signature.

tool_signatures.name: track_shipment
tool_signatures.description: Track the delivery status of a shipment (TMF621).
